reason: $29.99 for a month is more than what I pay now, and I wait for a real flash sale before I try anything new. The $24.99 launch price is closer, but it is only the first box and I would still be comparing it per day with what I already have.
objection: I can get a magnesium I already know for less per day. A lab report is nice, but I have no proof it works better for me than the cheaper one.
would_change_my_mind: A TikTok Shop flash sale or coupon that brings a one-month box down to about $19 to $20, or a cheap trial size so I can try it once without committing.
